home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Everything runs on your computer. Nothing goes through AdsConsole servers.
home.steps_hint: Three steps for the AI to start working on your accounts.
home.step_connect_hint: Google Ads or Meta Ads, with your own app.
home.step_client_hint: Paste the ready-made snippet into Claude, Codex, Gemini or Cursor.
home.step_first_call_hint: Ask the AI something like "list my campaigns". This step checks itself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostart_hint: The MCPs are available as soon as you turn on your computer.
settings.port_hint: AI clients need the new port after you change it.
settings.secrets_keychain: System keychain. Tokens and keys stay in the operating system vault.
settings.secrets_file: Local file readable only by your user (the keychain was not available).
settings.up_to_date: You are on the latest version.

conn.title: Connections
conn.subtitle: Ad accounts the AI can access, through your own app on each platform.
conn.remove_desc: This connection credentials are deleted from the keychain. The AI loses access to its accounts.
conn.name: Connection name
conn.name_hint: Just for you to recognize it, e.g. Main agency.
conn.waiting_hint: Finish signing in in the browser window. It takes up to 5 minutes.
conn.templates: Privacy policy and redirect page templates

google.title: Connect Google Ads
google.desc: Uses your own Google Cloud project. Takes about 10 minutes the first time.
google.step1: Create a project and enable the Google Ads API
google.step2: Set up the consent screen and publish the app
google.step3: Create a Desktop app OAuth client and download the JSON
google.login_customer_hint: Only if you reach the accounts through an MCC.

meta.title: Connect Meta Ads
meta.desc: Uses your own app on Meta for Developers.
meta.step1: Create the app with the ads use case and link it to your business portfolio
meta.step2: Create the Facebook Login for Business configuration
meta.step3: To publish the app: privacy policy and redirect page
meta.relay_hint: Required with the app in Live mode. Leave empty in development mode.
meta.token_hint: System User or user token. It stays only in the keychain.
